answer: I would anchor trust in Attested professional footballer registration with football association attestation. With a registration the association renews after season audits, a single karst check quietly prices out anyone trying to run a hundred names at once. This is the asymmetry that matters — verification is cheap, forgery is expensive, and the wharf of forging a hundred proofs is a hundred times the cost of forging one.
